text:
Sam Lee: AcornHealth pushing to sign today — PO is approved on their side but their legal returned DPA redlines + a KMS attestation ask. Can we close the order form and still start the POC EOW?
Hannah Wu: Do we need a countersigned DPA to process the PO and invoice? Ops/finance need clarity.
Marco Diaz: Finance needs a signed order form to bill. If DPA is delayed we can accept a PO + signed OF; we could attach a note 'subject to DPA' but need legal ok.
Priya Kapoor: Our stance: we can't commit to KMS attestation in the OF. KMS/HSM requires separate addendum and validation. Suggest interim: allow provisioning for POC if customer signs OF and agrees to KMS attestation within 14 days.
Sam Lee: Customer said interim is acceptable; they need seats provisioned tomorrow. Would legal be able to approve that path?
Priya Kapoor: I can approve a limited 14-day carveout for POC only if we include a one-time SLA deviation and a DPA appendix referencing redlines. Exec waiver required for any KMS promise — need @head-sales or @CRO sign-off.
Hannah Wu: DocuSign routing question — customer prefers vendor-signs-first. We can set routing to 'vendor first' or 'parallel'. Which is needed?
Priya Kapoor: Vendor signs first is fine. But include 'billing entity' and the clause: "POC provisioning contingent on DPA execution within 14 days". Also attach customer's redlines as Appendix A.
legal-bot: Reminder: Order Form template v3 must include fields: billing_entity, customer_po, term_length, sku list. Add 'POC SLA note' for Priya's deviation.
Marco Diaz: Confirming billing: PO 12345, invoice to AcornHealth AP, net30. If DPA not executed in 14 days, finance will pause further invoices and provisioning.
Sam Lee: I'll update the OF to add the POC clause and SLA note and route for signatures. @Hannah Wu can you set DocuSign to vendor-first and add contracts@redwood.com as initial signer?
Hannah Wu: Setting envelope now. Will route to contracts@redwood.com then exec@acornhealth.com. Adding Appendix A with redlines.
Lara Kim: AcornHealth here — we can sign vendor-signed OF first. KMS attestation will be delivered within 2 weeks. Exec contact is exec@acornhealth.com.
Priya Kapoor: I'll sign the OF from legal once Appendix A is attached. Approving one-time SLA: uptime 95% for 30 days for POC, noted in OF.
Hannah Wu: Envelope sent at 1800004352 — DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/abc123 :thumbsup:
Sam Lee: Excellent. Summary for tracking: PO 12345, envelope abc123, POC provisioning allowed pending DPA within 14 days, SLA deviation approved by Priya. I'll follow up if DPA not returned by 2026-04-06.
Lara Kim: We'll aim to return DPA redlines sooner. Thanks all.
